operational_policy.name: 목적 단계 규칙
operational_policy.design_context: declared in this revision after prior synthetic results were available; not retrospective preregistration

normalization.rules: raw: binary pref/level/device; goal affinity in [0,1]; roadmap 1/.7/.4/0
normalization.preference: declared interests plus historical top-two topics only when actual behaviour Rw has nonzero entries; diagnostic admission is not behaviour

operational_policy.goal_affinity_limitation: Goal affinity is declared domain knowledge also used by the synthetic generator; synthetic superiority is not independent evidence.

replacement_rule.applies_to: future policy changes from this revision; not retroactive pre-registration
replacement_rule.confirmation: new data after policy freeze; synthetic checks do not establish learner effect

validation.mode: next-week observed quiz-pass; targets fixed before prerequisite filtering
validation.population: users with at least one attempt in the evaluation week
validation.target_policy: unique evaluation-week quiz passes, unpassed and level-eligible at snapshot; prerequisite filter excluded from target definition
validation.idcg_policy: sum of 1/log2(rank+1) through min(full_relevant_count, k); unchanged by prerequisite filtering
validation.repeat_pass_policy: deduplicate within evaluation week; previously passed units excluded when exclude_passed=True
validation.zero_target_policy: retain as NDCG=0; also report positive-target-user mean
validation.short_list_policy: pad with -1; padded ranks have zero gain; fixed k IDCG
validation.aggregation: one request per evaluation-week active user; arithmetic user mean
